answer.justification: Layer-1 relative L2 of 0.088 sits in the fine-tuned range (0.086-0.092), below quantized (0.096-0.105) and system-prompted (0.113-0.133). The mid-layer size ratio of 1.016 means the internal state grows, which matches fine-tuned (1.017-1.023). Quantized and system-prompted both shrink it. The layer-2 spike of 0.2 is tiny, which rules out system-prompted (31.7-64). KL of 0.142 and top-1 agreement of 0.904 fit fine-tuned, and the median first divergence of 2 is closer to fine-tuned than to quantized (10-17). Direction consistency of 0.627 also matches fine-tuned (0.618-0.705), as does 4 refusals dropped. Layer-8 and layer-16 L2 (0.163, 0.155) are slightly below the usual fine-tuned range at layer 16, but the rest fits. Base is ruled out because every difference is non-zero.
